senelec.title: IPM Medical Coverage Management System (Internal Project – SENELEC)
senelec.description: Development of a web application designed to automate the management of medical coverage requests for SENELEC employees and dependents. The system enables centralization of files, tracking of request status, validation by relevant departments, and generation of statistical reports.

djimasou.title: DJIMASOU GLOBAL TRADING SERVICE

carim.title: CARIM Imaging — Radiology and Medical Imaging Center
carim.description: Development of a professional showcase website for CARIM Imaging, a medical center based in Grand Yoff (Dakar), specializing in radiology and medical imaging. The site presents the various examinations (MRI, CT scan, Ultrasound, ECG, etc.), practical information, and allows patients to contact the center directly.
